acceptance: all preregistered per-market gates plus positive common-index lower bounds on both markets
episode: 0.5 sleeve from next open after positive-to-non-positive base exit until first daily recross at or before 168H or exact 168H expiry
estimator: sum(current segment completed episode targets)/(segment count+2)
reset: after two consecutive completed targets <= 0, discard the entire segment and reset loss count; triggering losses are not retained
strategy_boundary: own-instrument completed lagged history -> same-instrument future unlevered long/cash
target: 0.5 * arithmetic open-to-open carry + 0.0005 only on restoration
